content:
carmen: Quick sync — Cloud Marketplace HackDay (partner-run integration labs) at CloudSummit. We need to finalize speaker list, dev env images, and a fallback if live demos fail.
ryan: +1. Tentative schedule attached in drive: https://drive.redwood/marketplace-hackday — can we lock speakers today?
aditya: I can take lead on dev env images. Partners want to bring their containers; we should standardize base image and creds.
elena: Shipping note — swag pickup for partners arrives Wed 8am to the green room. Who's coordinating badge access? @ryan? :package:
ryan: Yep I'll handle badge list. Need final partner headcounts by tomorrow EOD.
jordan: Questions on fallback: do we want prerecorded videos per partner or a central demo VM that ops can spin up?
aditya: Prefer per-partner short 3-4min pre-recorded clips + repo with sample app. Less ops fiddling.
ops-bot: Reminder: capacity for lab VMs is 40 concurrent. Autoscale requires 48hr notice.
aditya: Good call — we should cap workshop signups at 36. Also need test API keys for SI partners (read-only). Can security generate ephemeral keys?
elena: Security can issue scoped keys. I'll ping SecOps and ask for a temp key template.
carmen: Run-of-show draft: 10:00 intro, 10:10 partner intros, 10:25 3 parallel labs (each 22 min + 3 min rotate), 11:30 lightning Q&A. Thoughts?
ryan: Works. Can we make partner slots 20 + 5 for handoff to keep on time?
jordan: Also add 2x 5min buffer in case of audio issues.
aditya: For reproducibility, I'll publish a single docker-compose and a quickstart script. Example command for partners:

```
# start local integration lab
docker-compose -f redwood-partner-lab.yml up --build -d
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $PARTNER_KEY" http://localhost:8080/health
```

aditya: Will add env var checks and a small troubleshooting section.
elena: Swag ops: partners can bring co-branded stickers and 2 small swag bins. If they ship to office, label boxes MRD-HACKDAY.
carmen: Marketing needs final partner logos + 1-sentence blurbs for the registration page. @ryan can you chase?
ryan: On it. Also need speaker headshot + short bio by Thurs.
jordan: For the live stream: we'll use the partner booth RTMP to the main room. Any partners without RTMP capability should send a high-res video by Friday.
aditya: I'll prepare a minimal test harness and a small synthetic dataset so demos don't hit live customers.
elena: Ops note — networking: partners using their own hardware will need a VLAN. Submit ticket with VLAN reqs by Wednesday.
carmen: Backup plan summary: 1) switch to pre-recorded vid (partner-provided) 2) run central demo image with sample payloads 3) redirect attendees to self-serve repo + support channel.
ryan: Let's codify fallback in a single doc and link in runbook. Can someone own it? @carmen?
carmen: I'll own fallback doc and coordinate with @aditya for the artifacts.
jordan: Last bit — promo UTM tags for partners, please use utm_source=marketplace_hackday&utm_partner=<name>. Marketing will stitch analytics.
aditya: I'll add a small README to each partner repo with the UTM example and curl snippets.
elena: Final logistics checklist: partner headcount, swag labels, badge list, VLAN requests, pre-recorded vids, test keys. I'll create a checklist in shared doc.
ops-bot: New task created: #1123 — Provision 36 lab seats and VLAN requests. Due: 1761310000.
ryan: Great. Everyone, please update the shared sheet by EOD tomorrow. Thanks! :raised_hands:
